limitations: Final target wallet cohorts are selected from completed target receipts and thus are retrospective. Any historical overlap is a discovery witness, not a causal feature unless independently available at the candidate decision time.
Current holder screening is a bounded sample and does not authenticate common ownership; no RPC funding/transfer graph was run here.
Curve reserve ratios are observation snapshots and not finite-size execution prices. A return to a low reserve and lack of rtokens_raw==0 are not fraud verdicts.
The first event seen in a receipt copy can lag actual chain creation; one-second timestamps cannot disambiguate same-second order.
Paper OPEN/CLOSE rows report chronology only; they carry actual_fill_established=false and are not real executed trades.

time_methodology.chain_time: event_timestamp seconds from decoded successful curve receipts, preserving separate slot/transaction/event ordering where available.
time_methodology.creation_proxy: First observed successful curve event; not claimed to equal authenticated mint creation.
time_methodology.entry_proxy: Paper OPEN timestamp from local ghost_trades for each case; actual_fill_established remains false in these rows. Entry chronology is not PnL.
time_methodology.observer_time: received_at_ms captured by collector. Difference from event_timestamp*1000 is reported descriptively and is not treated as calibrated network latency.
time_methodology.same_second: Strictly prior means event_timestamp < cutoff second; same-second events are unresolved at one-second timestamp granularity.
time_methodology.success: Receipt copies were frozen per-case by their manifest; source decoder excludes failed transactions and unsupported/non-SOL events.
